source: PCI DSS v4.0.1, Requirements 6.4.3 and 11.6.1 (surface-level external checks only)

checks.name: Script Inventory
checks.description: All scripts loaded on payment pages must be inventoried and have documented business justification.

deductions.reason: Excessive third-party scripts on payment flow

checks.name: Subresource Integrity (SRI)
checks.description: All third-party scripts must have integrity attributes to prevent supply-chain attacks.
checks.notes: Payment provider scripts often cannot use SRI due to dynamic versioning, these are exempt.

checks.name: Third-Party Script Risk Classification
checks.description: Third-party scripts should be classified by risk based on vendor reputation and access level.

findings.elevated_reason: can record what a customer types, including data entered into payment fields

checks.name: Content-Security-Policy Header
checks.description: CSP header must be present and restrict script sources. Essential for PCI 11.6.1 change detection.

moderate.description: Some permissive directives but broadly restricted

checks.name: Security Headers Suite
checks.description: HSTS, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, and Referrer-Policy must all be correctly configured.
